replies.body: To add on to this appeal, you and several others were warned in the chat to stop using this; 10 minutes later, you continued.

replies.author: Mitomon
replies.body: I did not notice. I only saw a bunch of kill messages and players saying to not tell others how to get infinite eggs.That only those clever enough could figure it out. I decided it was an Easter egg( I would make this pun) and messed with it, found out how to do it, and had fun with it. I had no idea it was not allowed.
